findings.suggested_fix: Trace TP-10 and TP-11 to REQ-6 and design EP-2 (started field contract) instead of S-3/AC1. Or mark them as contract tests beyond the ACs.
findings.text: TP-10 (invalid started gives 400) and TP-11 (absent or empty started) are mapped to S-3/AC1. That AC only asks for exactly the 09:00 and 09:30 appointments, so neither test asserts it.

findings.text: The plan says every test name starts with HMS-21 and its REQ id, as the strategy requires. But the tests[] titles start with 'API:' or 'Web:', and no test lists a REQ id.

rubric_items.reason: All 14 ACs (S-1 AC1-5, S-2 AC1, S-3 AC1-3, S-4 AC1-5) appear in at least one covers list, and each has a test that really asserts it.
API rules are tested at integration level and web rendering at unit level. There is no e2e or manual level, which matches the strategy's gaps.
The new started field has a negative test (TP-10) and edge tests for absent or empty values (TP-11). The count has a boundary test at exactly now (TP-3), and zero cases are covered (TP-4, TP-9).
Tools and folders match the strategy and layout. But the plan says each test name starts with HMS-21 and its REQ id, and its own test titles do not.
Readable, runnable titles. But the Scope says there are 16 acceptance criteria when the stories have 14, and the titles leave out the REQ ids.
